scenarios.purpose: The one real retain call made live during the demo
scenarios.outcome_to_retain: On 28 September 2026 payments-api had a SEV1 incident: p95 latency 4.4 seconds and 502s after deploy v2.22, with the sqlalchemy QueuePool limit reached error. Rolling back to v2.21 (RB-09) fixed it in 9 minutes. Restart and scale-out were not attempted because earlier incidents INC-002 and INC-006 showed they fail on this signature. Outcome: rollback worked. Root cause: another connection leak introduced by v2.22.
